items.title: Disney+ looks to TikTok creators to bring fan content to its short-form video feed
items.summary: As streamers compete with social media giants for viewer attention, Disney+ is partnering with TikTok to bring creator content to its app.

items.title: MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
items.summary: MacPaw is building a local version of its AI assistant Eney using Liquid AI's models.

items.title: Robinhood to list a fund that lets anyone back Y Combinator startups
items.summary: Robinhood's latest financial instrument intends to let any retail investor feel like they, too, can make money by backing Y Combinator startups.

items.title: Indian EV startup River raises $120M Series C to scale production, launch more models
items.summary: River plans to build a new factory, launch additional models from 2027, and target profitability as it scales production.

items.title: Saudi Aramco backs India’s Mitti Labs to make Asia’s rice farming more water-resilient
items.summary: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.

items.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
items.summary: WindBorne Systems has raised $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

items.title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
items.summary: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

items.title: Elon Musk repeatedly one-upped his execs on SpaceX’s first earnings call
items.summary: Musk kept inflating the already-big promises being made by SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and Gwynne Shotwell on the company's first call.

items.title: Lucid’s turnaround plan hinges on $1.4B in cash savings, robotaxis
items.summary: Lucid's new CEO Silvio Napoli listed four must-win priorities, including the successful launch of its midsize EV, finishing a factory in Saudi Arabia, cutting expenses, and robotaxis.

items.title: How to get the best hotel deals for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: We’ve partnered with hotels around Moscone West during Disrupt, taking place October 13 to 15, to secure the best prices available for attendees.

items.title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
items.summary: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.

items.title: SpaceX doubles revenue on Anthropic and Google compute deals, Starlink growth
items.summary: SpaceX doubled its revenue compared to last year, according to its first quarterly earnings since going public in June.

items.title: Android app developers may be unwittingly sharing their users’ location data with advertisers
items.summary: New findings by the Electronic Frontier Foundation aim to warn app developers that some of the third-party code they place in their apps may also collect their users' location data when they grant permission to the app.

items.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
items.summary: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.

items.title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
items.summary: Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta.

items.title: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
items.summary: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.

items.title: Nvidia doesn’t mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it’s already showing progress
items.summary: The week-old Open Secure AI Alliance, spearheaded by Nvidia and grown to over 120 companies, already has proposals out for defending against AI agents.

items.title: Waymo opens up robotaxi service in Dallas to everyone
items.summary: Waymo has dropped the waitlist for its robotaxi service in Dallas, the latest step in the company's bid to scale its self-driving technology across the United States, U.K., and Europe.

items.title: Take an extra $100 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass: This week only!
items.summary: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

items.title: TV Time co-founder launches Bingers to revive the beloved TV-tracking app
items.summary: Bingers is a new TV and movie tracker that revives the social features fans loved with TV Time, while adding support for importing their viewing history.
